added_failures_note: Unmeasured: reviewed manifest baseline_suite and after_suite are both empty; suite explicitly unarmed. No suite logs exist to derive a measured delta; null is not a measured zero.

assertion_analysis.fails_if: Float64 is disabled or the actual selected JAX backend is not GPU; changing platform or dtype configuration reddens these guards.

Stitching changes unary area above 1e-13 or produces an invalid/disconnected union; reinstating exact-union contiguity fails on the recorded 30-part mesh. Coordinate-rounding bound alone is weak because rounding to a 1e-14 grid normally moves coordinates by at most half that grid.
Boundary moment signs, radial partition or factors disagree with independently summed cell centroid moments by 2e-14; e.g. dropping the inner subtraction reddens it.
Meshed union differs from authored region above tolerance; overlay precision limits sensitivity below its grid and it is not used alone as evidence of exact preservation.
Production Newton solve reports non-convergence; exhausting iteration budget reddens these guards, but they do not certify physical accuracy.
Any low-mu shell or high-mu sphere probe stops improving at either refinement; a source/field regression causing constant or rising control error reddens it; high-mu shell orders are printed only.
Shapely unary area subtraction cannot resolve the known independent 0.1 square-metre change.
A genuine 20 mm disconnection is accepted or another assertion masquerades as the expected disconnection refusal; deleting the connected-polygon check causes the explicit else raise.
Receipt lacks passing physical controls, or text overlaps/clips/intersects data; figure-negative-control.log records the deliberate collision refusal and EXIT=1.

assertion_independence: No added test assertion equates a returned value with the same configurable value supplied as its oracle. The collocation residual and result.converged guards measure algebraic convergence only; they are not independent physical-accuracy checks.
delivery_blocker: Review contract requires an integer added_failure_count derived from absent suite arms; missing evidence must not be replaced with a fabricated zero. Coordinator must reconcile the unarmed-suite review contract.

reuse.reason: the reuse shortfall is the duplicated figure-save checks in a measurement script (finding 1); no product code is duplicated

figure_review: Rendered exact submitted SVG extracted with git show using ImageMagick and visually inspected reviewed-figure.png; all four panels, labels and legend readable, no overlap or clipping.
